quests.title: Fill an empty column
quests.ask: Every cell below the robot is empty. Leave exactly one gem on each of them, and none on the robot's own cell.
quests.nudge: Which cell is the robot on when it decides whether to put a gem?

quests.title: Leave a full column alone
quests.ask: Here every cell already holds a gem. Walk to the bottom and leave the column exactly as it was.
quests.nudge: When should the robot keep its gem in the bag?

quests.title: Gaps at both ends
quests.ask: The first and last cells below the robot are empty and the middle ones are full. End with one gem on every cell.
quests.nudge: Does your program treat the last cell the same way as all the others?
